summary: Examples of debug: conditional message with facts, printing a registered result at higher verbosity, dumping all hostvars, and multi-line messages using a lookup.
questions: How do I print all facts and variables for a host?
How do I show a registered result only in verbose mode?
How do I print multiple lines with debug?
How do I print the default gateway only if it exists?

answer_card.title: debug examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: System {{ inventory_hostname }} has gateway {{ ansible_default_ipv4.gateway }}
  when: ansible_default_ipv4.gateway is defined

- ansible.builtin.debug: {var: result, verbosity: 2}
- ansible.builtin.debug: {var: hostvars[inventory_hostname], verbosity: 4}

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg:
      - "line one {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'YOUR_KEY') }}"
      - "line two"
```
